about_the_game:
Flaunt is a clicker character and outfit collection game with multiplayer social and mini game features, built for ongoing expansions and updates. Items are sold directly through the Steam store via card packs and individual character purchases. When updates roll out, items become delisted—once delisted, they can only be obtained through trading or marketplace purchases from existing owners.

Item Acquisition

Card packs provide a streamlined way to obtain higher rarity items (all card pack divine chances at 5%), and free item drops are available every 12 hours (free divine chances at 0.01%). Items can be exchanged up for higher rarities all the way to divine. Currently, only one divine-rarity item (HQK-80) can be obtained through exchanges.

Rarity Classes

Divine Items: A planned update will introduce advanced exchanges, allowing players to reroll divine items for a chance at any existing divine in-game. We're working with our Discord community to finalize a method for obtaining permanently delisted divine items that the community is happy with.

Limited Items: These can only be acquired through special events or prizes. Once obtained, they're exclusively available through player trading or marketplace sales.

  • Community-Driven Development via Discord

  • Clicker game with a skill tree system

  • Mini-games

  • All Items Tradable on Steam Marketplace

  • Evolving Storefront – the Character Store completely refreshes with each new Tour, introducing exclusive outfits and characters that become marketplace-only once delisted

  • Guaranteed Item Drops Every 12 Hours of Playtime

  • Exchange System for Higher Rarity Items

  • Fully Animated and Interactive Characters

  • 9 Unique Characters with Distinct Styles

  • 27 Collectible Outfits – ranging from common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary, mythical, and divine. With special rarities of premium and limited.

  • 250-Player User-Hosted Chat Lobbies – meet others, chat with them, show off your characters, and check out their outfits.

Upcoming Update #1 Notes (SEA TOUR)

  • Complete store refresh with 6 new characters and 2 card packs

  • Debut Tour items will be delisted

  • 6 new characters and 6 new outfits

Upcoming Update #2 Notes

  • Blackjack multiplayer mode

  • Advanced exchange system with divine item rerolls

Flexible Community Driven Planned Future Content

  • Pet companions

  • Character customization options

  • Back view for characters

  • Advanced character posing and interactivity

  • Camera mode

  • New backgrounds

  • Male characters

  • Expanded multiplayer modes

  • Custom rooms with furniture placement

  • Additional character interaction animations

  • More multiplayer mini games

  • Item salvaging for materials and rewards

  • Expanded localization

  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card with up-to-date drivers
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Collect and show off rare characters and outfits in a social clicker game. Click to earn and upgrade with the skill tree, sell and buy in the marketplace, hang out in massive lobbies, and race to grab limited-time items before they're gone forever.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Indonesian, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Thai
